instructions: Expected needs are service intentions, not a claim that a suitable approved resource exists. Adjudicate acceptable resource IDs and eligibility with caseworkers before scoring ranking accuracy. A no-match is valid when constraints cannot be met; never force results. Crisis cases must bypass normal ranking. Keep synthetic variants separate from this independent case count.
